gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate hospice volunteering opportunities available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or region should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic area to narrow down local hospice organizations.

questions.title: Have you volunteered with hospice or end-of-life care before?
questions.description: Understand the user's prior experience to tailor the type of opportunities they should pursue.

questions.title: What kind of volunteer role interests you most?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants direct patient contact, administrative support, bereavement support, or another role.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Determine time availability to filter opportunities that match the user's schedule.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred setting, home visits or facility based?
questions.description: Establish whether the user wants to visit patients at home, in a hospice facility, or has no preference.

questions.title: Is there a timeline for when you want to start?
questions.description: Understand urgency so the plan can prioritize fast-track applications or allow time for training programs.

questions.title: Are there any personal constraints like transportation or background checks?
questions.description: Surface any logistical limitations that could affect which opportunities are actually accessible to the user.
